section_summary.extract_value: This Materials section describes the measurement instruments used in the study. Participants completed the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS), a 13-item measure rated on a 5-point scale. Women also completed the Photographic Figure Rating Scale (PFRS) to assess actual-ideal weight discrepancy, while men skipped this section. The study measured self-esteem using Rosenberg's Self-Esteem Scale (RSES) and computed BMI from self-reported height and weight. Demographic data including sex, age, religion, and marital status were collected.
